title: ACQUIRE Industries
content:
ACQUIRE Industries is a Canadian advanced materials supplier focused on insulation, heating, and power integration products. The company markets aerogel insulation blankets for residential, commercial, industrial, and transportation applications.

  • Coverage Area: Canada and the United States
  • Focus Areas: Aerogel blankets, thermal breaks, building insulation, transportation insulation, and energy-efficiency materials
  • Current Brands Represented: AEROLL™ aerogel insulation products
  • Official Website: https://acquireindustries.com
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
